items.label: Sturdy and Easy to Use
items.value: Unlike ordinary plant supports, K-Brands plant stakes are designed to keep your plants standing tall and thriving! Made with premium-grade materials, including a rustproof steel core and a protective plastic powder coating, these stakes ensure enhanced durability and reliability for long-lasting performance

items.label: Convenient 12-Pack
items.value: This set of 12 plant supports is perfect for all your gardening needs! Each stake measures 16” in length with a 10” diameter, making them ideal for supporting a wide variety of plants. Enjoy the flexibility and ease of use that comes with having plenty of supports on hand

items.label: Multi-Purpose Versatility
items.value: K-Brands plant supports are incredibly versatile! Whether you use them individually, in circles, or in long rows, these supports adapt perfectly to your plants' needs. They’re an excellent choice for both indoor and outdoor gardening, helping you create a beautifully organized space

items.label: Seamless Design
items.value: The elegant dark green color blends naturally with your garden, allowing your plants to shine while staying securely supported. No distractions, just a seamless, beautiful look

items.label: Includes 10Ft Plant Tie
items.value: To make your gardening experience even easier, each pack includes a 10-foot plant tie roll. This helps your plants grow strong and straight, ensuring they stay healthy and flourish with minimal effort on your part

items.label: Recommended Uses for Product
items.value: Gardening, supporting plants, both indoor and outdoor settings
